description: This file defines the ImpactProjectItem class, which manages impact items associated with projects in the Goteo impact assessment module. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, and validating impact project items, and manages relationships with impact data, projects, and impact items.

classes.name: ImpactProjectItem
classes.description: A model class representing an impact-related item linked to a project, with methods for managing its data and relationships.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the impact project item.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the impact project item.

methods.name: setImpactItem
methods.description: Sets the ImpactItem associated with this impact project item.

methods.name: getProject
methods.description: Returns the Project object associated with this impact project item.

methods.name: setProject
methods.description: Sets the Project associated with this impact project item.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value associated with this impact project item.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value for this impact project item.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves an ImpactProjectItem by its ID.

methods.name: getListByProject
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ImpactProjectItems associated with a specific project.

methods.name: getListByProjectAndImpactData
methods.description: Retrieves impact project items linked to a specific project and impact data.

methods.name: getListByProjectAndFootprint
methods.description: Retrieves impact project items linked to a specific project and footprint.

methods.name: getImpactDataProject
methods.description: Fetches the ImpactDataProject associated with this impact project item.

methods.name: getCosts
methods.description: Retrieves cost information related to this impact project item.

methods.name: getCostAmounts
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total amount of costs associated with this impact project item.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves this impact project item to the database.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks if the impact project item has all required fields properly set.
